objective: Benchmark Gahyeon Korean STT and TTS end-to-end latency, accuracy, and blinded listening quality
constraints: Do not deploy, promote, or switch providers
Preserve checkpoint, prompt-set, runtime, and synthesis-setting identities
Use a fixed Korean prompt and audio set with identical preprocessing and loudness
Verify every blind listening review before requesting human selection

requiredGates.name: impact-analysis
requiredGates.evidence: 2026-08-26 GitNexus upstream impact for scripts/build_piper_listening_review.py:main was LOW with one direct file entry point and zero affected processes. Staged detect_changes found one changed function, zero affected processes, LOW risk.

requiredGates.name: regression-test
requiredGates.evidence: python3 scripts/test_piper_listening_review.py passed 3 tests, including one objectively selected candidate plus the operating baseline. The generated review was independently accepted by scripts/verify_blind_tts_review.py with 2 candidates and 5 matched prompts each.

humanGates.name: blind-listening
